questions.question: The smallest repeating unit that defines the entire lattice structure is called

explanations.a: A space lattice is an array of points showing how particles are arranged.
explanations.b: Lattice point is a single point in the space lattice.
explanations.c: Bravais lattice is a classification of lattices.
explanations.d: Unit cell is the smallest repeating unit.

questions.question: The Unit cell that contains only one lattice point at the corner is known as

explanations.a: Space groups describe symmetry, not cell type.
explanations.c: Lattice point is a location, not a cell.
explanations.d: Primitive cells contain only one lattice point, formed from corner atoms.

questions.question: The number of equidistant nearest neighbors that an atom in the given structure has is called

explanations.a: Correct: Coordination number defines the number of nearest neighbors.
explanations.b: Lattice constant is the physical dimension of the unit cell.
explanations.c: Atomic packing factor is a measure of atom density.
explanations.d: Nearest neighbor distance is a length, not a count.

questions.question: The number of lattices in the orthorhombic system is

explanations.a: Correct: Orthorhombic system has 4 Bravais lattices.
